q_001.sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 5;
q_001.answer: Rock (826.65), Latin (382.14), Metal (261.36), Alternative & Punk (241.56), TV Shows (93.53)

q_002.sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';
q_002.answer: For Those About To Rock We Salute You, Let There Be Rock

q_003.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

q_004.sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM MediaType mt LEFT JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1;

q_005.sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1;

q_006.sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId;
q_006.answer: Music (3290), Movies (0), TV Shows (213), Audiobooks (0), 90’s Music (1477), Audiobooks (0), Movies (0), Music (3290), Music Videos (1), TV Shows (213), ... and 8 more

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2021';

q_008.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AverageInvoiceTotal DESC;
q_008.answer: Chile (6.66), Ireland (6.52), Hungary (6.52), Czech Republic (6.45), Austria (6.09), Finland (5.95), Netherlands (5.80), India (5.79), USA (5.75), Norway (5.66), ... and 14 more

q_009.sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpending, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC) AS SpendingRank FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC LIMIT 5;
q_009.answer: Helena Holý (49.62, 1), Richard Cunningham (47.62, 2), Luis Rojas (46.62, 3), Ladislav Kovács (45.62, 4), Hugh O'Reilly (45.62, 4)

q_010.sql: SELECT a.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS genre_count FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3;
